newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian coconut and copra prices firmer.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian coconut and copra prices firmer.

text.p: Indonesian coconut oil and copra prices firmed on Friday, boosted by bullish overseas trends, traders said.
They said coconut oil was quoted at 1,400 rupiah/kg in Jakarta against 1,350 rupiah/kg last week. Copra rose to 885 rupiah/kg in Jakarta against 650 rupiah/kg.
"Local prices are going up after many traders exported coconut oil due to the bullish trend overseas, in addition to the stronger dollar," said one trader.
"Export activity has led to tight supply in the local market. Offer prices have been low in the past two months because there has been so much coconut oil around," he added.
Traders said cooking oil, which is the refined form of coconut oil, also rose to 1,630 rupiah/kg against 1,600 rupiah last week, because of the improving market sentiment.
Traders said prices were stable at $600/tonne FOB Kuala Enok in Riau and that about 20,000 tonnes of coconut oil had been transported to Rotterdam this week.
Coconut oil supplies in Rotterdam increased to 13,229 tonnes as of June 17, against 10,223 the week before.
